resources.string: 18Duo is your Home with gesture navigation.
So the Home gesture and the Home button return to 18Duo.
Open Default Home app (opens automatically)\nTap 18Duo\nGo back; this sheet continues with step 2
Performs Back, Home and Recents and opens system panels. It never reads screen content.

Open Accessibility → General tab
Scroll down to Downloaded apps
Tap 18Duo Navigation gestures → turn on → Allow
If blocked by “Restricted settings”: 18Duo app info → More (⋮) → Allow restricted settings, then retry
Swipe up for Home, pause for Recents, swipe inward from an edge to go back.
Open System navigation (opens automatically)\nChoose Gestures\nReturn to 18Duo; gestures turn on automatically
Needs a one-time wireless-debugging authorization on this phone. Gestures work without it.
Settings → About phone → tap OS version 7 times\nDeveloper options → Debugging → Wireless debugging\nTurn it on, tap Pair device with pairing code, then tap the 18Duo bubble and enter the code
